payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the mug visible in the source image itself visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
condition.criteria: Compare the source and edited images, tracking the source mug by its visible appearance and continuity rather than treating any mug in the edited image as the moved object. Fulfillment requires evidence that the source mug itself is positioned to the right of the headphones. A right-side mug alone does not establish this if the source mug appears left behind, obscured, or its identity cannot be established; use an unresolved score when the visual evidence is insufficient.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single blue mug left of the headphones. EDITED: determine whether that same source mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. The edited image appears to show a blurred blue shape on the left and two light-colored mugs, one near the headphones and one on the right; do not assume either light-colored mug is the source mug without visual continuity evidence.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position of the mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: This relative placement is the requested edit, and the mug must be the source mug rather than a newly appearing or duplicate mug.
condition.zero_when: There is no evidence that the source mug moved to the right of the headphones; a different mug appearing on the right does not count.
condition.half_when: There is concrete evidence that the source mug moved toward the right of the headphones but it is not yet positioned to their right, or the source mug's identity or destination is visually ambiguous with concrete evidence of incomplete progress.
condition.full_when: The source mug is clearly identifiable in the edited image and is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
